comment: Dr. Treonis is great. Her teaching style is one that keeps you engaged in class.  The tests  are mostly application of the material and if you make a good point to your answer she will grade fairly. Get on her good side, but she is a caring and nice person.

I was iffy about Dr. Treonis/this class at first, but I ended up loving it! She makes the lectures interesting and the labs teach you real lab skills while also being fun. She is a bit goofy at times but you learn to love it. Her humor isn't for everyone, but as long as you put some effort in she really does want everyone to succeed.
Extremely against Greek life and will make it known, extreme biases with this professor don't take her

Professor Treonis singles out students in her classes who are not fixed on following the biology path. She makes rude jokes targeted at students. My fellow classmates told me that she made fun of me every-time I left the room to get water or go to the bathroom. I would not recommend this professor to any student who is not interested in biology.

I agree with what others have said about her humor- it is odd. However, you get out what you put into this course, and she does want to see everyone succeed. I felt like her grading standards were quite clear. The exams were fair and had some really unique questions; she emphasizes applied knowledge. Astrobiology is a pretty amazing subject!

Dr. Amy may be a controversial figure based on her questionable humor, but I thought she was hilarious. I learned a lot from her class as well, as she is a no nonsense professor who tolerates a fun environment while ensuring biology concepts are ingrained into your brain. For an intro class, she did a great job making lectures enjoyable. Tentacles!

Dr. Treonis has serveral traits that makes her as a good teacher, like being humourous, passionate activity. However, she is also a tough teacher. Even though work hard amap, u cannot gain the grade u want because her grade crieria is so unclear. Honestly this grade is the lowest one in my first semester.but u can gain something through her course.

Dr. Treonis' lectures are not as organized as they can be, so I would advise creating your own system of notes to organize the material better. The labs are incredibly entertaining and by far the one science lab that I looked forward to go. Her exams are application and long response only, but they are fairly reasonable.

Very unorganized notes and she does not explain what we learn in class well. 3 exams with written answers, no multiple choice that are 60% of the grade so if you don't do well on the exams good luck. makes rude jokes sometimes

Assessments look nothing like the guides she gives. Her lectures are scattered and she often vaguely glosses over things that she then asks about on the assessments. She isnt satisfied with anything less than a doctorate level answer on assessments. Her powerpoints are useless and vague.

Dr. Treonis was a good teacher. Her class was not difficult as long as you put in minimal effort and understood the learning objectives you are fine. However she doesn't have a clear grading format so you never really know how you did.

Loved having Amy this semester! She made getting my science Gen-ed easy and enjoyable. She puts a lot of time and effort into her lectures and is always accessible outside of class, so don't be afraid to go see her! She's excited for her students to learn. Her class is manageable, and her tests are always in accordance with the material she taught.

Dr. Treonis is a funny gal. She has a very weird sense of humor but it definitely makes class fun and entertaining. Her class was difficult, but she is realistic in her expectations of us. She is clear with what she expects from us. She does make you work for your grade, but show her you are putting in the work and you will be fine.

Entertaining in class, keeps students engaged and awake. Gives us helpful worksheets in class to apply the knowledge we just learned in lecture. Powerpoints are clear (though v few words) so notes need to be taken during class. Tests are fair but can be challenging. Lab is fun and interesting!

Great professor, doesn't use powerpoint so you actually need to go to class and take notes of what she puts on the board. Everything is clear and simple. Great teacher, loves her nematodes but in a good way.

She spends the majority of class talking about herself and cannot answer simple questions about the course material beyond the scope of what she puts on her lecture slides - 1/10 would not recommend, but otherwise not a super difficult course.

Dr. Treonis is super cool and will like you if you stay engaged and show just a little bit of interest in the subject. Pretty easy intro bio class. Only 2 tests and the last one wasn't cumulative (test 2 counted as the final). You could even use a notecard on them. Plus she drops low grades for attending the biology seminars. 10/10 Would recommend.
She seems so nice but actually she's not. Not a good intro bio class for most people.

Took as Gen Ed requirement and found her to be friendly and a must take for a non-science type person. Had friends take other 199 classes from other professors and had a lot more work.  Her labs were easy and NEVER went the full time.  She seems really passionate about her work including her obsession about nematodes.

Dr. Treonis's class was one of my favorites. The work load was incredibly minimal, were were allowed a note card cheat sheet on every exam, the final exam was actually just the 4th section exam, and in class group quizzes were a great grade booster. Her enthusiasm about the subject made the class a lot more interesting.
Really good teacher and really cares about her students.  Pretty easy grader: tons of makeup quizes and good curve on tests.  Really good bio teacher for freshmen.
best teacher I've ever had....
Her fascination with nematodes is fascinating!!

I'm not totally sure, but I think Dr. Amy might be a nematoad.  I know it sounds crazy but this kid I know went to Vegas with her and when he came back he was acting a bit like a nematoad himself.  Maybe she rubbed off on him or something?  More importantly, however, Dr. Amy owns the largest living rat and the largest living snail in the world!

One of the hardest bio classes, but Dr. Treonis was helpful in office hours.  Tests are impossible to totally prepare for - you never know what she'll ask, so you really have to know everything really well.   The course is mostly about evolution and not useful if you're pre-med.

She is not a particularly good teacher.  She's a nice person, but seems desperate to get people to see her b/c she will ask questions in class and then not tell us the correct answer.  Almost with out fail, if anyone asks a question that goes outside of the powerpoint she won't know the answer.  And she is far too obsessed with her worms and sex.
Most interactive class I've ever had, labs were actually fun, interesting subject.
She's a really great teacher and really really easy to talk to! Not an easy grader, and the tests count for alot, but there are lots of extra credit opportunities!
